facts.summary: Phase II sepsis topline showed no clear overall benefit vs placebo, only a High Risk UTI signal · Phase 2 · Allocetra in sepsis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Relative analysis demonstrates a potential indication of effect of Allocetra™ as compared with placebo in high-risk, severe sepsis patient population (organ failure scores >=7), originating from urinary tract infections (“High Risk UTI”).
evidence.safety: Stand-alone and placebo-compared analysis across all sepsis patient subgroups and risk categories demonstrated acceptable safety and tolerability profile of Allocetra™ IV infusions.
